title: Flash-sale checkout
blurb: Repair a flash-sale checkout workflow that oversells stock, mishandles retries and failures, and corrupts cancellation state.
brief:
A flash-sale service creates and prices orders, authorizes inventory reservations, completes checkout, and returns stock when a completed order is cancelled. Production traffic exposed several interacting failures: limited stock can be oversold, retries repeat side effects, authorization errors strand orders in an intermediate state, and cancellation does not preserve inventory.

Read the repository and tests as one checkout contract. Preserve the public API, exact pricing behavior, and concurrency between unrelated SKUs. Requests that already reached a terminal state must remain retry-safe.

**Your job:** make the full checkout lifecycle correct under retries, failures, and concurrent calls without weakening the tests or globally serializing independent products.
